# SoulCue

> SoulCue is a free AI-powered emotional wellness app for iPhone. It provides daily emotional check-ins, mood tracking, and AI coaching to help users understand their emotions, reduce anxiety, and build emotional resilience.

## About SoulCue

SoulCue is available free on the iOS App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/soulcue-ai-growth-coach/id6754840010

SoulCue is not a therapy app and is not a replacement for professional mental health care. It is a daily emotional wellness tool designed to build self-awareness and emotional regulation habits.

Key features:
- Daily emotional check-in (2-5 minutes)
- AI coaching based on how you feel
- Mood tracking and pattern recognition
- Audio journaling
- Emotional regulation exercises
